archive_sha256_contract: Observe quarantine SHA256 for replay only; independently pre-fixed member Git blob identities bind selected content.
documentation_boundary: Official docs establish API 302 Location flow and archive stability limits; they do not establish this commit’s exact Location or root.
failure_policy: Preserve partial/full archive and already verified members. One terminal SOURCE.json or FAILED.json. Cleanup errors separate; never mask primary error.
git_mode_mapping_basis: Git executable-bit identity mapped conservatively to tar 0644/0664 or 0755/0775; all other modes fail closed. No tar mode is restored.
outer_requirements: Parent supplies established WNOWAIT supervisor, hard limits and shared absolute deadline, validates independent exit0/elapsed/tree/log/receipts. Worker is not supervisor.
permissions: all selected regular files 0600 data; upstream 100644/100755 recorded only; no chmod/build/install/source execution
transport_reviewed_meaning: Parent approved this exact proposed allowlist contract, not a claim that the Location or prefix was observed. Actual mismatch fails closed and retains the same quarantine asset; no automatic retry or broadened root.
